sentences.en: Don't dash off a sloppily written report filled with mistakes.
sentences.zh: 别匆忙写一份满是错误的报告。

sentences.en: Will your report be finished in time for the meeting?
sentences.zh: 你的报告能来得及在会议前完成吗？

sentences.en: I am terribly busy because the report deadline is near.
sentences.zh: 因为报告截止日期快到了，我忙得要死。
